<!-- pr-reviewer: c70e8430994513801724c50662d826b1e1050fe5 -->
**Verdict: Needs changes before merge.**

This is a SAFETY-tier review: the PR changes toolpath generation and posted G-code for the Bore operation.

This review is the build that the earlier read-only review on this head asked for ("not built - needs a maintainer look"). It replaces the `needs-maintainer` label with `needs-rework`. The notes of the earlier review stay valid.

Thank you for this work, @sn3ro. The design is clear and the tests are strong. Two items block the merge. Both are small.

## What looks good

- The helix rides the same wall circle as the ring ladder (`rc = R - r - leave`). It uses half-turn arcs, the same pattern as `thread_ride.rs`, so each arc posts as one G2/G3 with Z.
- `BoreParams::validate` refuses the two unsafe cases before any move is built: a core at the floor, and a helix steeper than 15 deg. Each message gives the value that fits.
- The move to the centre at the floor is safe, because the core door proves `rc <= floor reach`.
- Climb is CCW and conventional is CW. This agrees with the ring ladder.
- The project file stays compatible: `helical` and `spring_pass` are written only when true. An older file reads as Rings. The stamp does not change for a ring ladder.
- Detect holes skips and names the holes that one helix cannot clear.
- The MCP field list, the guide, the refusal reference and the decision record are all in the PR.
- No golden under `tests/golden/` moves. No snapshot PNG changes. No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` in new non-test code. `bore_helix.rs` has its provenance comment.

## Results, merged with main (locally)

Trial merge: PR head `c70e84309` with upstream main `aa4c785db`. Git merges the text with no conflict. The merged tree does **not compile** (item 1 below).

Run with `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --only ...`, on the merged tree:

- `debug build: app (--no-run)`, `debug build: ui (--no-run)`: ok.
- Motion suites: 119 steps, 118 ok, 1 failed: `motion suites: equal_steps` (compile error, item 1). The other 118 include `bore_helix`, `bore_ramp_angle`, `center_cut_law`, `entry_ramp_angle`, `level_links`, `refusal_ghost`, `top_z_level` and `lib`.
- App suites, all ok: `lib`, `bore_helical`, `bore_entry`, `break_through`, `coarse_rims`, `hole_wall_flats`, `ladder_entry_height`, `mill2d_c`, `refusal_location`, `stepped_stock_rapid`, `stock_source_holes`, `stock_source_verdict`, `thread_mill_rim`, `mcp`, `mcp_provider`, `mcp_wire_contour`, `sinker_side`, `setup_align_hole_kinds`, `lathe_workholding_kinds`, `deburr_unreachable`.
- `ui suites: lib`: ok.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-geometry -p camcraft-cl -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: failed on the same compile error.

I then added the one missing field locally (not pushed). With it, clippy is clean, and `equal_steps` and `bore_helix` pass.

Extra suites run: none were owed. The PR does not change `testdata/` or a fixture directory, and it does not change import code.

Heavy lanes: I did not run them again. The PR body says the motion and app heavy lanes ran on `c70e84309`: 231 steps, 0 failed. Please run them again after the merge of main.

### Mutations (run by the reviewer)

| Mutation in `crates/motion/src/machining2d/bore_helix.rs` | Result |
|---|---|
| M1: `helix_leaves_core` accepts `rc` up to two times the floor reach | red: `a_hole_one_helix_cannot_clear_is_refused_with_the_widest_it_can` (motion), `a_hole_too_wide_for_one_helix_is_refused_through_the_operation` (app), `detect_for_a_helical_bore_skips_the_holes_one_helix_cannot_clear` (app lib) |
| M2: no floor circle (the spring pass gives one circle) | red: `the_counterbore_is_one_helix_on_the_wall_then_a_floor_circle_and_never_a_plunge`, `the_spring_pass_is_a_second_floor_circle` |
| M3: `MAX_HELIX_ANGLE_DEG` 15 -> 45 | red: `a_helix_steeper_than_the_limit_is_refused_with_the_pitch_that_fits` |

All three mutations go red. The tests pin the safety doors well.

## Requested before merge

1. **The merge with current main does not compile.** Commit `9998a1c82` on main added a new `BoreParams` literal at `crates/motion/tests/equal_steps.rs:285`. It does not have the field `strategy`:
   ```
   error[E0063]: missing field `strategy` in initializer of `camcraft_motion::machining2d::BoreParams`
      --> crates/motion/tests/equal_steps.rs:285:17
   ```
   Fix: merge `upstream/main` into the branch (do not rebase). Add `strategy: Default::default(),` to that literal. Search the merged tree for other new `BoreParams {` and `OpParams::Bore {` literals. Then run the quick gate and clippy again.
2. **Add before/after screenshots to the PR body.** The PR changes `crates/ui/src/egui_app/holes_page.rs`: a new Strategy combo and a Spring pass check on the Passes tab, and the "Helix pitch" label on the Heights tab. Show the Passes tab with Rings and with Helical, and the Heights tab with Helical. Do not commit images to the tree. Put them on a separate images-only branch of your fork and link them from the body.

## Questions and notes (not blocking)

- **Non-centre-cutting tools on a small helix.** The plunge law (`plunge_law::first_solid_plunge_as`) sees only moves with no XY run. A helix always has XY run, so the law never stops it. When the hole is only a little larger than the tool, `rc` is small. Example: a 6.5 mm hole, a 6 mm tool and a 0.4 mm pitch give `rc = 0.25` mm and pass the 15 deg door. A non-centre-cutting tool then cannot cut the material under its centre. The other helix entries in the code have the same gap, so this is not new in this PR. A minimum `rc` for a tool that is not centre-cutting could be a follow-up issue.
- The default Bore stepdown (often 5 mm) is refused for the Helical strategy, as the body says. A clear message tells the user the pitch to type. That is acceptable. A seed pitch when the user selects Helical could be a later improvement.
- `crates/app/src/project/params.rs` (1799 lines), `params_impl.rs` (2660) and `operation/generate.rs` (4163) were already over the 400-line limit. Each grows by a few lines. This does not block.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
I set this PR to draft again. The review on c70e84309 asks for two changes, and a ready PR takes no pushes. I will push the changes, update the body and flag the PR ready again.

Both review items are done. The new head is 4bd091166.

1. Merge of main: 8f3f15be7 merges `upstream/main` at 2d98d87be. The merge has no conflict. Commit 4bd091166 adds `strategy: Default::default(),` to main's new Bore literal in `crates/motion/tests/equal_steps.rs`.
2. Screenshots: the PR body has a new "Screenshots" section. It shows the Passes tab and the Heights tab, each with Rings and with Helical.

Class: NEW CODE (a merge of main plus one test commit). The test commit changes only `crates/motion/tests/equal_steps.rs`.

Gates on 4bd091166:

- Quick gate (`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`): 724 steps, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` on the 8 touched crates: clean.
- Heavy lanes (`cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`): 240 steps, 0 failed. The 6 known-fail steps (#1950, #2849) are red as expected.

Air cut: the air cut is not done yet. I can air-cut the counterbore case after the review.

Ready for a re-check.
